errors.text_span: Оста Y е обозначена като "Приходи (в трлн. долара)"
errors.evidence: The Y-axis is not labeled. The text "Приходи (в трлн. долара)" comes from the legend entry for the blue area data series ("Обобщени данни (в трлн. долара)"), not from an axis label.

errors.text_span: На графиката е представена линия в тъмнокафяв цвят
errors.evidence: The chart does not contain a dark brown line representing revenue. It shows a blue area chart for this data series, as indicated by the legend "Обобщени данни".
The starting value for the revenue in 2017 is 9.50 trillion dollars, not 5,009,50. This appears to be an OCR error combining the y-axis tick '5,00' with the data label '9,50'.

errors.text_span: Линията започва от 13% през 2018 г., достига 14% през 2019 г.
errors.evidence: The description swaps the percentage growth values for 2018 and 2019. The chart shows a growth of 14% in 2018 and 13% in 2019.

The description omits the intermediate revenue values which are explicitly labeled on the chart for each year from 2018 to 2022: 10.80 (2018), 12.20 (2019), 14.00 (2020), 16.20 (2021), and 19.30 (2022).
